features.feature: CSV upload of a lead list, ARV + repairs + MAO per row
features.quote: Upload addresses, get ARV + Repairs + MAO for every row. Batch underwriting for real estate wholesalers. 3 free - no credit card.
Upload your lead list. Get consistent, send-ready max offers back in minutes. Same assumptions, every row, every time.
BatchOffers uses the RentCast AVM API to estimate property values and a formula-based approach to compute rehab costs, maximum allowable offers, and deal scores.
(ARV × Discount %) − Repairs − Closing Costs − Holding Costs − Assignment Fee
Medium rehab ($30), Standard discount (70%), 3% closing, $3,000 holding, $10,000 assignment.

features.feature: Deal score plus confidence per row
features.quote: Offer price, repairs, spread, and a deal score for every address. Focus on Strong deals first.
Low - repairs exceed 35% of ARV or data may be incomplete. Verify this deal manually before making an offer.

features.feature: Skipped rows with reasons; dedupe; no charge for provider failures
features.quote: Duplicate addresses in the same batch are automatically deduplicated and don't consume credits. We aim to avoid charging for provider-side failures
The CSV includes ARV, repairs, MAO, spread, and deal score. Send to your buyer as a clean one-page worksheet.
How wholesalers use BatchOffers for daily lead processing, skip trace prioritization, JV deal scoring, disposition prep, and market entry research.
Coverage varies by market. Vacant land, new construction, and rural properties may not return results.
